review.notes: Checked against full judgment, no changes. The order itself falsely recorded 'The taxpayer has not filed the reply for the show cause notice dated 01.09.2023' despite two replies (03.11.2023, 21.11.2023) being on record with DRC-06 proof of upload -- reply_not_considered/defect_found is squarely supported at para 4. Outcome disposed/remanded matches para 5-6 (order set aside, remanded for fresh consideration with a hearing).
